name: Branding
overview: Scripture addresses the concept of branding both literally and figuratively, cautioning against marking the body in ways that dishonor God, as seen in Leviticus 19:28. The moral integrity and spiritual identity of believers are emphasized, with Genesis 39:9 illustrating Joseph's refusal to sin against God despite temptation. True identity and worth come from God’s approval and the redemptive work of Christ, who is recognized as sent from God (John 3:2) and offers eternal life to all who believe (John 3:16). Believers are called to receive one another in faith without judgment (Romans 14:1), reflecting a Christ-centered community marked not by physical signs but by faith and obedience.
